datasets.name: ds_phase_summary
queryLines: WITH r AS (   SELECT     platform, test_type, scale, warehouse_size, warehouse_size_type,     optimization_strategy, strategy_slug,     CASE WHEN platform = 'databricks' THEN concat('DBX/', lower(strategy_slug))          ELSE concat('SF/',  lower(strategy_slug)) END AS combined_label,     COUNT(*) AS query_count,     SUM(duration_ms) AS sum_duration_ms,     AVG(CAST(duration_ms AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_duration_ms,     MAX(CAST(duration_ms AS BIGINT)) AS max_duration_ms,     CAST((unix_timestamp(MAX(end_time)) - unix_timestamp(MIN(start_time))) AS DOUBLE) AS wall_clock_seconds   FROM tpcds_sf_catalog.tpcds.results_queries   WHERE (platform = 'databricks' AND strategy_slug IN (:dbx_strategies))      OR (platform = 'snowflake'  AND strategy_slug IN (:sf_strategies))   GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8 ) SELECT r.platform, r.test_type, r.scale, r.warehouse_size, r.warehouse_size_type,   r.optimization_strategy, r.strategy_slug, r.combined_label,   concat(r.test_type, ' / ', r.combined_label) AS phase_strategy,   CASE r.test_type WHEN 'ingestion' THEN 1 WHEN 'power' THEN 2 WHEN 'concurrency' THEN 3 ELSE 99 END AS phase_order,   COALESCE(p.tier, '(unpriced)') AS tier,   r.query_count, r.sum_duration_ms, r.avg_duration_ms, r.max_duration_ms, r.wall_clock_seconds,   ROUND(r.sum_duration_ms / 3600000.0 * COALESCE(p.units_per_hour, 0) * COALESCE(p.price_per_unit, 0), 4) AS cost_usd_summed,   ROUND(r.wall_clock_seconds / 3600.0 * COALESCE(p.units_per_hour, 0) * COALESCE(p.price_per_unit, 0), 4) AS cost_usd_wallclock,   COALESCE(p.unit_label, 'unit') AS unit_label FROM r LEFT JOIN tpcds_sf_catalog.tpcds.results_prices p   ON p.platform = r.platform  AND p.warehouse_size = r.warehouse_size  AND p.warehouse_size_type = r.warehouse_size_type  AND p.region = 'us-east-1'  AND p.tier = (CASE WHEN r.platform = 'databricks' THEN :dbx_tier ELSE :sf_tier END)

datasets.name: ds_query_ingestion
queryLines: WITH q AS (   SELECT r.platform, r.scale, r.warehouse_size, r.warehouse_size_type, r.q_id,     r.strategy_slug,     CASE WHEN r.platform='databricks' THEN concat('DBX/', lower(r.strategy_slug))          ELSE concat('SF/',  lower(r.strategy_slug)) END AS combined_label,     AVG(CAST(r.duration_ms AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_duration_ms,     SUM(r.duration_ms) AS sum_duration_ms,     COUNT(*) AS exec_count   FROM tpcds_sf_catalog.tpcds.results_queries r   WHERE r.test_type = 'ingestion'     AND ((r.platform = 'databricks' AND r.strategy_slug IN (:dbx_strategies))       OR (r.platform = 'snowflake'  AND r.strategy_slug IN (:sf_strategies)))   GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7 ) SELECT q.platform, q.scale, q.warehouse_size, q.warehouse_size_type, q.q_id,   q.strategy_slug, q.combined_label,   COALESCE(p.tier, '(unpriced)') AS tier,   q.avg_duration_ms, q.sum_duration_ms, q.exec_count,   ROUND(q.sum_duration_ms / 3600000.0 * COALESCE(p.units_per_hour, 0) * COALESCE(p.price_per_unit, 0), 4) AS cost_usd FROM q LEFT JOIN tpcds_sf_catalog.tpcds.results_prices p   ON p.platform = q.platform AND p.warehouse_size = q.warehouse_size  AND p.warehouse_size_type = q.warehouse_size_type AND p.region = 'us-east-1'  AND p.tier = (CASE WHEN q.platform = 'databricks' THEN :dbx_tier ELSE :sf_tier END)

datasets.name: ds_query_power
queryLines: WITH q AS (   SELECT r.platform, r.scale, r.warehouse_size, r.warehouse_size_type, r.q_id,     r.strategy_slug,     CASE WHEN r.platform='databricks' THEN concat('DBX/', lower(r.strategy_slug))          ELSE concat('SF/',  lower(r.strategy_slug)) END AS combined_label,     CAST(regexp_extract(r.q_id, '^q([0-9]+)', 1) AS INT) AS q_num,     AVG(CAST(r.duration_ms AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_duration_ms,     SUM(r.duration_ms) AS sum_duration_ms,     COUNT(*) AS exec_count   FROM tpcds_sf_catalog.tpcds.results_queries r   WHERE r.test_type = 'power'     AND ((r.platform = 'databricks' AND r.strategy_slug IN (:dbx_strategies))       OR (r.platform = 'snowflake'  AND r.strategy_slug IN (:sf_strategies)))   GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8 ) SELECT q.platform, q.scale, q.warehouse_size, q.warehouse_size_type, q.q_id, q.q_num,   q.strategy_slug, q.combined_label,   COALESCE(p.tier, '(unpriced)') AS tier,   q.avg_duration_ms, q.sum_duration_ms, q.exec_count,   ROUND(q.sum_duration_ms / 3600000.0 * COALESCE(p.units_per_hour, 0) * COALESCE(p.price_per_unit, 0), 4) AS cost_usd FROM q LEFT JOIN tpcds_sf_catalog.tpcds.results_prices p   ON p.platform = q.platform AND p.warehouse_size = q.warehouse_size  AND p.warehouse_size_type = q.warehouse_size_type AND p.region = 'us-east-1'  AND p.tier = (CASE WHEN q.platform = 'databricks' THEN :dbx_tier ELSE :sf_tier END) ORDER BY q.q_num, q.q_id
